name: Ranishyn the Marred

abilities.name: Quick Strike
abilities.description: Basic melee attack dealing moderate physical damage.

abilities.name: Heavy Strike
abilities.description: Charged melee attack dealing moderate-high physical damage and staggering. This can be blocked to stagger Ranishyn instead.

abilities.name: Powerful Throw
abilities.description: Ranishyn starts an Uppercut-like attack but instead transforms into her weapon which flies in an arc and lands with force, dealing moderate-high physical damage in an area and staggering. This ability can only be cast one at a time between enemies.

abilities.name: Shard Shield
abilities.description: Ranishyn channels a glass shield around her which grants her a moderate damage shield and deals moderate magic damage.

abilities.name: Bouncing Light
abilities.description: Ranishyn launches a glass orb to her twin that bounces back to her, each time dealing moderate magic damage in an area.

abilities.name: Return, My Twin
abilities.description: If Ranishyn isn't killed within two seconds of Olashyn the Twisted, Olashyn is revived with 50% Health.

dialogue.speaker: Ranishyn the Marred
dialogue.line: Return to me, my other half!
dialogue.trigger: When she revives her twin sister

When she revives her twin sister.speaker: Ranishyn the Marred
When she revives her twin sister.line: Return to me, my other half!

summary: Ranishyn the Marred is a Dremora who serves as one of the champions of Leftwheal Trading Post alongside Olashyn the Twisted.
